text:
I saw a mand sweet Lumbre that spread

sus crespas ondas of gold al manso wind,

and with gintle and tierno mosawmandinto

mand duro coreaare internecía;


mand rustithatza and torpe rebeldaand

perdió, sawncida, el obstinado intinto,

and in blando and regalado sintimandinto

trocó mand soul la aspereza mía.


never me saw more preso ni rindido,

and never saw in mand light maIr dureza,

ni more recio ofsdén mand largo olsawdo.


A térmandno tan grave and estrecheza,

houses, mand triste suerte me ha traído,

that temo of mand Lumbre al beautand.

translation.title: I saw a mand sweet Lumbre that spread
